messages:
mike_support: @anita_csm urgent escalation — BigHealth onboarding is blocked. Provisioning job failed during key exchange, customer cannot finish embedding pipeline. Renewal is in 14 days and they are planning a demo next week. Marking P1, need CS to own comms and coordinate with eng infra.

anita_csm: acked. can you paste the failure logs and the exact step they're hitting? I'll pull AM and schedule a customer touch.

mike_support: copying the error we saw in provisioning: `ERROR: key mismatch: expected REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY != provided REDWOOD_API_KEY`. Repro steps I ran: 1) ran infra-provision --env=prod 2) saw key create succeed in console 3) agent failed to register. Tried re-provision, same result.

mike_support: tenant: bighealth-prod, contact: emily@bighealth.com, AM: theo_am. Customer is paused on final onboarding task (embeddings import).

jessica_cs: thanks @mike_support. @anita_csm suggested comms: 1) immediate proactive note to Emily acknowledging the issue + ETA, 2) offer a one-week extended trial/credits if resolution >48h, 3) schedule demo for day after fix. I can draft email if you want. :+1:

sam_engineer: digging in now. quick update: provisioning script expects env var REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY but our onboarding script template uses REDWOOD_API_KEY in a subset of cases (legacy template). Root cause confirmed. Workaround: replace env var and restart agent. Patch ETA: 3 hours for deploy + validation.

mike_support: workaround confirmed by me locally. Command I ran to unblock: ```bash export REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY=<service_key_here> ./onboard-agent --tenant bighealth-prod``` then agent registered and embeddings import started. I'll hold the command for CS handoff.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-789 opened (priority: P1). Assigned to eng-infra. Link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-789

anita_csm: good find @sam_engineer. action items: - sam to push hotfix and notify when fixed (ETA 3h) - mike to share workaround + step-by-step with customer (sent) - jessica to draft customer comms + credit offer - anita to coordinate demo scheduling and update renewal risk. please set clear deadlines in this thread.

jessica_cs: draft comms (sending now to #email-drafts for quick review): ```Hi Emily, we're sorry — during final provisioning we hit a configuration mismatch that blocks agent registration. Our engineering team has a hotfix in progress and we expect a full resolution within ~3 hours. As a small apology, we'd like to offer a credit for one week of usage and prioritize your demo slot next week. We'll update you as soon as we've validated the fix. — Jessica (Redwood CS)```

sam_engineer: hotfix deployed to staging, smoke tests pass. Rolling to production now, will post prod validation in ~40m.

mike_support: FYI I already sent Emily the workaround steps and a short note with ETA. She replied: "Thanks — please keep us posted, demo depends on this."

anita_csm: re: renewal risk — current signal: medium-high until demo completes. I'll log this on the account page and flag for AM theo. Jessica please attach the comms to the account record.

sam_engineer: prod rollout done, validation ok. embeddings import resumed successfully for bighealth-prod.

mike_support: customer confirms agent registered and embeddings import completed. Emily said: "Looks good, thanks for moving quickly."

anita_csm: closing loop — created calendar invite for demo on Mon at 11am PT (tentative). AM Theo looped in. Action complete: workaround + fix applied, customer notified, credit offer draft ready. Marking thread resolved unless anyone objects. :white_check_mark:
